column1: # The Debug Menu plugin's English (docs/plugins.md). One string a line: its Binary
# Ninja address in the 1.09 eboot, the 64-bit FNV-1a hash of the game's own
# UTF-16 text there, and the English, tab separated (\t, \n, \r and \\ escaped).
# The game's text is not in here: tools/debug_menu_strings.py shows it from
# your own eboot beside the English ("list"), lists what is left ("missing"),
# and checks every row ("check"): the hash, the printf conversions, the font.
